description: Contemporary reports give a February 1 strike onset, while the DDPR says the continuing Tšepong strike began sometime in January. Whether both descriptions concern one episode, and thus which unit owns it, is unresolved.
required_followup: Review the complete DDPR report and contemporaneous January/February coverage under fresh access gates; distinguish strike stages from first public assembly and record the supported onset month.

description: SABC reports more than 300 health workers had been picketing but does not state whether they were present together at one time. No sourced simultaneous count is available.
required_followup: Seek reporting or records that identify the public gathering dates, exact site and concurrent attendance; do not convert workforce totals or cumulative participation into a crowd estimate.

type: public picket location and start date
description: QMMH/Tšepong in Maseru is identified as the workplace, but the exact location and date of the first physical public picket are not established.
required_followup: Find event-level reporting that distinguishes strike/work stoppage onset from the first public picket and names where and when workers assembled.

description: The interim court order, expected return to work and search-only March 11 strike date do not establish the last physical public gathering.
required_followup: Check dated follow-up coverage and official records for the last public picket, keeping a workplace strike boundary separate from a gathering end date.

description: Salary parity and review demands are described in a public-private hospital context. Some sources frame the demand as directed to government or describe a prior state undertaking, while the employer statement is self-interested and not independent.
required_followup: Verify the workers’ direct demand and the government’s decision or policy responsibility from independent, event-specific reporting or records.

description: A 2022 State Department search excerpt says COLEPE delivered a petition to the Prime Minister on February 22, but no linked public gathering or crowd size is described in the available excerpt.
required_followup: Read the underlying report through a fresh gate and seek independent February 22 coverage that identifies any march or concurrent public crowd.

type: LFM public gathering and state target
description: Search-only coverage describes a drivers’ strike over workplace facilities. It does not establish public picketing, a qualifying crowd, or a government-directed demand.
required_followup: Read the Newsday report under a fresh gate and seek independent coverage of the location, turnout and whether the action addressed any state policy.

description: The consulted accounts do not establish any of the seven coded response categories or protester violence for the QMMH/Tšepong public picketing. The reported court interdict is outside those categories.
required_followup: Review event-specific court, police and contemporaneous reporting; leave each dimension unknown absent direct evidence.

description: Search coverage was limited to open-web indexes and returned material, with one Sesotho query and no systematic LexisNexis, archive or source-by-source national coverage audit. Results included unrelated out-of-period labor reports; absence of additional events is not established.
required_followup: Continue targeted local and Sesotho-language archive searches, verify apparent leads at body level, and document remaining geographic/source coverage before any completeness claim.
